blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport and fly to Cusco. On arrival, you will be met and transferred to your hotel.

In the afternoon, begin a tour of the archaeological sites around Cusco.

Visit Sacsayhuamán, a sacred Inca site. According to legend, people from other tribes were not allowed to enter.

Continue to Qorikancha, the Temple of the Sun. According to legend, in the 15th century the temple was decorated with gold and its altar took the form of a golden disc. After the Spanish arrived, they destroyed the temple and built a monastery on the site. An earthquake later damaged the colonial building, revealing the massive stone slabs of Qorikancha beneath it.

Then see Tambomachay, a water temple with pools and a system of channels, and Puka Pukara, the Red Fortress, which served as a defensive complex.

Return to your hotel after the tour. Overnight in Cusco.

An optional visit to Cusco Cathedral is available before the city tour. Duration: approximately 40 minutes; price: $25.

blocks.text:
From your hotel, transfer to the railway station and take the tourist train to Machu Picchu.

Hidden among the mountains, the city consists of stone buildings, terraces and other structures. It became known to the world in the 20th century following an expedition by an American explorer.

During the tour, explore Machu Picchu and take in the mountains and deep canyon. Afterwards, enjoy free time for photographs and an independent walk.

Then take the bus down to the village. Lunch is at El MAPI restaurant.

After lunch, return to the station, take the train to Cusco and transfer to your hotel.

Machu Picchu sits among high green mountains, so the experience extends beyond the buildings themselves. Terraces descend the slopes, deep valleys open up beyond the stone walls, and mountains are visible almost everywhere. Free time after the tour lets you explore at a gentler pace, take photographs and simply enjoy the city without rushing.
